books: cash_control from the registered nine-policy study

completion_policy_revision.reason: User removed fixed future-session counts from completion conditions; strategy and evidence-integrity requirements are unchanged.

counting: Consecutive eligible exchange sessions; missing feeds and failures remain reported, never silently dropped
decision: No automatic deployment. Require positive incremental evidence versus the matched cash control, operational paper parity, acceptable observed and gap risk, and a separately documented deployment decision.

descriptive_uncertainty_method.interpretation: Descriptive uncertainty under observed dependence assumptions, not a native execution rerun or a correction for all historical strategy selection
descriptive_uncertainty_method.method: paired moving-block bootstrap of daily net returns
descriptive_uncertainty_method.sampling: Sample contiguous five-session blocks with replacement; concatenate and truncate to the observed session count; use identical date indices for both books
descriptive_uncertainty_method.statistic: Difference in compounded net return of selected and cash-control books

evaluation: Matched session returns and marked drawdown, completed trade lifecycles and active days
Net results under baseline, separate cost/liquidity stress and combined stress
Selected-versus-control incremental net return, turnover, concentration and return per unit of committed capital/time
Descriptive block-resampling uncertainty for paired daily returns; disclose inadequate block support and repeated looks, and report inconclusive evidence without blocking report completion
For rejected opportunities, evaluate a separate shadow position lifecycle; never credit unexecuted hindsight PnL to the portfolio
evaluation_window_policy: Evaluate the declared available window, with no fixed minimum session count. Disclose sample size, uncertainty and every reporting endpoint; completion does not establish independent performance.
execution: shadow_replay_or_paper_only; this file schedules nothing and sends no broker orders
hard_failure_conditions: Borrowing or exposure inconsistent with verified account capacity
KALCB intraday residual or unresolved terminal inventory/orders
management_tail: Disable new entries after the declared evaluation end; retain up to two scheduled OLR management sessions and report any remaining position or order as unresolved
required_observations: all eligible candidate opportunities before portfolio selection, including core-blocked candidates
decision timestamp, immutable features and snapshot hashes, route, score, rank and score support
portfolio state, intended quantity, admitted quantity and explicit rejection or resize reason
actual available buying power, pending commitments, order acknowledgements and partial fills where paper infrastructure provides them
marked equity, cash and exposures; signal-to-order and order-to-fill timing
risk-limit breaches, data failures, stale observations and required session management
retuning: No retuning inside this sample. A change creates a new registered experiment and requires a fresh independent evaluation cohort.

review_triggers.meaning: Research review triggers, not newly backtested liquidation rules and not a guarantee of loss limits

start: First complete eligible KRX exchange session after registration, subject to complete authenticated contemporaneous data
